findings.title: Plan documents are empty scaffolds
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) contain only frontmatter and the unreplaced placeholder comment. The scaffold comment tells the author to fill the required frontmatter fields and replace the placeholder comments. The `element` and `parent` fields are empty and the plan body is missing, so the plans record nothing. The same applies to sw-life-cycle-1-3-plan.md, sw-life-cycle-1-4-plan.md and sw-life-cycle-1-5-plan.md.

findings.title: Scaffold placeholder comment left in task documents
findings.why: task-002, task-003 and task-005 still contain the `wingfoil memory add` scaffold comment, which says to replace it. task-001 and task-004 have it removed, so the task documents are inconsistent.
